root_cause: QuestionCreatePayload in frontend/src/api/questions.ts defined flat top-level `stem`/`explanation` fields and AnswerOptionCreatePayload defined flat `body`. The backend createQuestionReq expects `translations: map[locale]translationReq` (with stem/explanation per locale) and answer option `translations: map[locale]answerTranslationReq` (with text per locale). Because the frontend sent `stem` at root level, `req.Translations` was nil, failing validateCreateRequest's stem-required check. The update path also sent `body` in option translations instead of `text`.
fix_description: Updated QuestionCreatePayload to use `translations: Record<string, { stem, explanation? }>` instead of flat `stem`/`explanation`. Updated AnswerOptionCreatePayload to use `translations: Record<string, { text }>` instead of `body`. Updated handleSaveDraft (create mode) to build the correct nested translations payload. Updated buildUpdatePayload to use `text` (not `body`) in answer option locale translations.
